text: BORA is the brand of Bora Lüftungstechnik GmbH of Raubling, Upper Bavaria, founded in 2007 by Willi Bruckbauer, who remains its CEO. The design magazine md calls Bruckbauer the sole owner (Alleininhaber) of Bora.
short: BORA is the brand of Bora Lüftungstechnik GmbH, founded, led and solely owned by Willi Bruckbauer.

source.name: KBBFocus: Bora CEO Willi Bruckbauer on the power of being a niche brand
source.quote: Bora Lüftungstechnik GmbH was founded in 2007 in Raubling, Upper Bavaria, by Willi Bruckbauer, 53, who remains the CEO.
